paper.title: Collective Memory and Spatial Sorting in Animal Groups

headline: Couzin et al. 2002 zonal collective motion (3-zone SPP): 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; wide Dzoo=12.0 parallel flock p=1.00 m=0.02; narrow Dzoo=4.0 low-p rotating state p=0.20 m=0.49 (mill m ceilings below locked 0.65); hysteresis gap=1.8 length-units

verdicts.gate: P1 mill at narrow Dzoo=4.0: mean p < 0.35 AND mean m > 0.65
reasons: narrow-zone (Dzoo=4.0) mean polarization p = 0.201 (need < 0.35; OK); mean angular momentum m = 0.493 (range [0.411, 0.546]; need > 0.65; FAIL)

verdicts.gate: P2 parallel at wide Dzoo=12.0: mean p > 0.9 AND mean m < 0.2
P3 hysteresis: mean |up_switch - down_switch| Dzoo >= 1.0 length-unit

extra.control_parameter: orientation-zone width Delta_zoo (narrow -> mill, wide -> parallel flock); only Delta_zoo is dialled
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Couzin zonal transitions (a milling/rotating state at narrow orientation, a parallel flock at wide orientation, and bistable hysteresis as the single zone-width parameter is ramped up vs down) and would catch an artifact — a phase portrait that vicsek_flocking (one alignment rule, no mill, no hysteresis) or boids (no zone-width control) cannot produce

citations: Couzin, I.D., Krause, J., James, R., Ruxton, G.D. & Franks, N.R. (2002). Collective Memory and Spatial Sorting in Animal Groups. Journal of Theoretical Biology 218(1):1-11. doi:10.1006/jtbi.2002.3065.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Couzin zonal transitions (polarization / angular-momentum order parameters vs orientation-zone width, and the hysteresis switch gap)
